_description: Cppcheck native rule policy - Common cppcheck error/warning strategies

default.risk_reason: Unknown cppcheck error type requires manual review.

unusedVariable.risk_reason: Unused variable removal is typically safe.

unreadVariable.risk_reason: Unread variable may be intentional for debugging or assertion.

constVariable.risk_reason: Const qualification addition is typically safe.

uninitvar.risk_reason: Uninitialized variable can cause undefined behavior.

uninitStructMember.risk_reason: Struct member initialization needs verification of intended initial values.

nullPointer.risk_reason: Null pointer dereference can cause crashes.

nullPointerRedundantCheck.risk_reason: Redundant null check removal needs verification of logic.

bufferAccessOutOfBounds.risk_reason: Buffer access out of bounds can cause memory corruption.

arrayIndexOutOfBounds.risk_reason: Array index out of bounds can cause memory corruption.

memoryLeak.risk_reason: Memory leak fix needs verification of ownership semantics.

resourceLeak.risk_reason: Resource leak fix needs verification of ownership semantics.

doubleFree.risk_reason: Double free can cause memory corruption.

deallocDealloc.risk_reason: Multiple deallocation can cause memory corruption.

useClosedFile.risk_reason: Using closed file can cause undefined behavior.

leakNoVarFunctionCall.risk_reason: Memory leak in function call needs verification.

returnLocalVariable.risk_reason: Returning local variable address can cause undefined behavior.

returnReference.risk_reason: Returning reference to local can cause undefined behavior.

autoVariables.risk_reason: Returning address of auto variable can cause undefined behavior.

danglingTemporaryLifetime.risk_reason: Dangling lifetime reference can cause undefined behavior.

comparisonError.risk_reason: Comparison error fix needs verification of intended logic.

returnAddressOfAutoVariable.risk_reason: Returning address of local variable causes undefined behavior after function returns.

autovarInvalidDeallocation.risk_reason: Freeing stack-allocated variable causes undefined behavior.

returnAddressOfFunctionParameter.risk_reason: Returning address of function parameter causes dangling pointer.

negativeMemoryAllocationSize.risk_reason: Negative allocation size wraps to huge unsigned value, causing exhaustion or corruption.

mismatchSize.risk_reason: Mismatched size argument may cause partial or out-of-bounds memory operations.

negativeArraySize.risk_reason: Negative array size is undefined behavior.

negativeIndex.risk_reason: Negative array index accesses memory before the array, causing undefined behavior.

insecureCmdLineArgs.risk_reason: Unbounded command-line argument copy can overflow fixed-size buffers.

integerOverflow.risk_reason: Signed integer overflow is undefined behavior in C.

floatConversionOverflow.risk_reason: Float-to-integer conversion overflow is undefined behavior.

uninitstring.risk_reason: Uninitialized string buffer may contain arbitrary data.

memleak.risk_reason: Memory leak fix needs verification of ownership semantics.

memleakOnRealloc.risk_reason: Realloc failure without temp pointer leaks original memory.

deallocret.risk_reason: Returning freed memory causes use-after-free in caller.

deallocuse.risk_reason: Using memory after free is undefined behavior and a security vulnerability.

mismatchAllocDealloc.risk_reason: Mismatched alloc/dealloc (e.g., malloc with delete) causes undefined behavior.

unusedAllocatedMemory.risk_reason: Allocated but unused memory can be safely removed.

assignBoolToPointer.risk_reason: Assigning boolean to pointer creates an invalid pointer value.

invalidFunctionArg.risk_reason: Invalid function argument may cause undefined behavior.

invalidFunctionArgBool.risk_reason: Wrong boolean argument type needs verification of function contract.

strPlusChar.risk_reason: Adding char to string pointer does pointer arithmetic, not concatenation.

ignoredReturnValue.risk_reason: Ignored return value may hide errors; needs intent verification.

wrongPipeParameterSize.risk_reason: Wrong pipe() parameter size causes undefined behavior.

memsetFloat.risk_reason: memset on float may not produce expected value on all platforms.

sizeofCalculation.risk_reason: Calculation inside sizeof is not evaluated at runtime; likely a logic error.

strncatUsage.risk_reason: Incorrect strncat size argument can cause buffer overflow.

selfInitialization.risk_reason: Self-initialization reads uninitialized value, causing undefined behavior.

uninitdata.risk_reason: Using allocated data before initialization may read garbage values.

uninitMemberVar.risk_reason: Uninitialized member variable needs proper initial value selection.

unusedStructMember.risk_reason: Unused struct member removal is typically safe but check ABI impact.

IOWithoutPositioning.risk_reason: Missing positioning between read/write causes undefined behavior per C standard.

readWriteOnlyFile.risk_reason: Reading from write-only file causes undefined behavior.

writeReadOnlyFile.risk_reason: Writing to read-only file causes undefined behavior.

wrongPrintfScanfArgNum.risk_reason: Mismatched format/argument count causes undefined behavior.

invalidScanfFormatWidth.risk_reason: Missing scanf width specifier allows unbounded input causing buffer overflow.

sprintfOverlappingData.risk_reason: Overlapping source/destination in sprintf is undefined behavior.

invalidscanf.risk_reason: scanf without width limit can overflow any fixed-size buffer.

shiftNegative.risk_reason: Shifting by a negative amount is undefined behavior in C.

shiftTooManyBits.risk_reason: Shifting by >= bit width of the type is undefined behavior.

shiftTooManyBitsSigned.risk_reason: Shifting signed value into or beyond sign bit is undefined behavior.

zerodiv.risk_reason: Division by zero is undefined behavior and causes hardware exceptions.

zerodivcond.risk_reason: Conditional division by zero may indicate logic error across code paths.

unknownEvaluationOrder.risk_reason: Unsequenced side effects cause undefined behavior.

knownConditionTrueFalse.risk_reason: Always-true/false condition may indicate logic error or dead code.

unreachableCode.risk_reason: Unreachable code removal is typically safe after control flow verification.

redundantAssignment.risk_reason: Redundant assignment overwritten before read is safe to remove.

constStatement.risk_reason: Statement with no effect may indicate incomplete expression or typo.

unusedFunction.risk_reason: Unused function removal is safe if linkage is verified.

unassignedVariable.risk_reason: Unassigned variable may be conditionally set; needs path verification.

selfAssignment.risk_reason: Self-assignment (x = x) is a no-op, likely a typo.

duplicateExpression.risk_reason: Duplicate expression in comparison likely indicates copy-paste error.

stringLiteralWrite.risk_reason: Writing to string literal is undefined behavior, may cause segfault.

uselessAssignmentArg.risk_reason: Modifying function parameter value has no effect on caller.

patterns.risk_reason: Volatile-related changes may affect hardware or concurrency semantics.
Interrupt path changes need manual timing and safety review.
Register access changes may affect hardware behavior.
Dynamic memory allocation in embedded systems needs review.
Dynamic memory deallocation in embedded systems needs review.
Memory copy operations need size verification.
String copy without bounds checking can cause buffer overflow.
Format string functions without bounds checking can cause buffer overflow.
